d:
Ekdam aasan aur svadisht Dhaba Style Dum Aloo banaen ya ghar ke samany tarike se, Tips ke sath. khare masalon se bani yah Kashmiri Dum Aloo aapke sare parivar ko pasand aayega. chhote aalu ko masaledar grevi men bani yah Restaurant Style Dum Aloo ki sabji ko kuk karne men samay bhi kam lagta hai. yah Step by Step Dum Aloo Recipe in Hindi pasand aae to sabsakraib jarur kar lijiyega
Ingredients for Dum Aloo Curry
Aalu - Potato - 500g
Tamatar - Tomato - 4 (300g)
Hari mirch - Green Chilli - 1
Adrak - Ginger - ½ inch
Kaju - Cashews - 10-12
Bari ilaichi - Black Cardamom - 1
